model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial on a commercial claim (CI). DOS 2025-01-19; 277CA confirms payer accepted the claim 2025-01-27 (STC*A2:20), 8 days post-DOS. The claim was timely. Per reference 03-timely-filing.md, proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal disputing the receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 but 277CA shows claim accepted for processing 2025-01-27, only 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. Denial is erroneous.

next_action.detail: Appeal with the 277CA acceptance report (date 2025-01-27, TRN TRC75364521) as proof of timely filing. Dispute the payer's receipt date.

evidence.fact: Both lines denied CAS*CO*29; MOA N211; $0 paid; CLP status 4 (denied)
STC*A2:20*20250127 — claim accepted for processing on 2025-01-27, 8 days after DOS
Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal disputing receipt date (03-timely-filing.md)

citations.rule: Proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report: dispute the receipt date
